findings.summary: hasPendingWork folds in cluesPublished unconditionally, but clueFromWorker publishes a clue with the terminal status 'blocked' when depth+1 > maxDepth (src/harvest.ts:145-154). A tick whose only publications are over-maxDepth clues therefore reports hasPendingWork=true although the post-write board is fully terminal, enqueuing one extra trigger that the following tick resolves to false. This over-approximates in the safe direction — convergence and drain termination still hold, and it never strands work — so it does not violate the liveness intent of spec §1.3, only the literal '当且仅当' phrasing. Narrowing the count to clues published with a non-terminal status would make the field exact.
